description: This file provides functions and constants for CJK-aware character counting and token estimation, accounting for non-Latin scripts in language models.

methods.name: estimateStringChars
methods.description: Returns an adjusted character length that accounts for non-Latin (CJK, etc.) characters, ensuring accurate token estimation.

methods.name: estimateTokensFromChars
methods.description: Estimates the number of tokens from a raw character count based on a fixed ratio.
